title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government has responded to a report on artificial intelligence and public standards, outlining their plans to address the concerns and recommendations raised in the report. The response aims to ensure that the development and use of AI in the UK align with public standards of safety, security, and trustworthiness.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: This document outlines Ofqual's policy for regulating artificial intelligence in qualifications, responding to government requests for guidance. It aims to address the use of AI in the qualifications sector responsibly.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This document is a report and assessment on the use of copyrighted materials in the development of artificial intelligence. It examines the impact of using copyrighted works in AI system creation.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: This document outlines the UK government's response to a report on artificial intelligence by the House of Lords Select Committee, addressing concerns and suggestions made by the committee to improve AI regulation and safety in the UK. The report aims to provide a comprehensive plan to mitigate the risks associated with AI and ensure its benefits are harnessed for the good of society.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This document outlines the terms of reference for a review committee that will examine the relationship between artificial intelligence and public standards. It likely covers the committee's objectives, scope, and guidelines for the review process.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The UK's Committee on Standards in Public Life (CSPL) has submitted evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on how to regulate Artificial Intelligence. The submission aims to contribute to the development of effective governance for AI in the UK.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This AI policy aims to address how artificial intelligence affects the regulation and evaluation of medical products, such as devices, treatments, and medications. The goal is to implement guidelines from the Artificial Intelligence White Paper to improve the process.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the Defence organisation the world's most effective, efficient, and trusted user of AI technology. This goal will be achieved by leveraging AI capabilities to strengthen the organisation's overall performance.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: The Transport artificial intelligence action plan is a policy document that aims to harness the benefits of artificial intelligence in the transport sector while minimizing potential risks. It outlines how the UK Department for Transport will collaborate with the transport industry to successfully integrate AI technology.

title: Copyright and artificial intelligence: progress report
description: A progress report on the use of copyright works in the development of AI systems, under Section 137 of the Data (Use and Access) Act.
summary: This document provides an update on the use of copyrighted works in the development of artificial intelligence systems. It focuses on the regulations set by Section 137 of the Data (Use and Access) Act.
